observations: Photos show a removed vehicle transmission/gearbox assembly in a workshop setting.
The casing has multiple ports/bosses and a large circular bell-housing area; no clear readable label/plate is visible.
No clear brand/model markings are readable on the gearbox in the provided photos.
Seller text mentions Ford Fusion and 4 cylinder, but the photos do not show the engine/vehicle identification.

claims.evidence: Photos show a gearbox but no readable Ford Fusion/part number/label to confirm vehicle fitment.
Photos show only the gearbox; no engine displacement/cylinder count is visible.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission type/fitment (e.g., wrong Ford Fusion transmission variant, wrong gear ratios, or wrong mounting/bell-housing for the specific engine/year).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission identification tag/label (part number) and/or the VIN/vehicle details it came from; also a photo of the transmission code stamped on the case.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used gearbox with uncertain fitment (worst case: may not bolt up / not compatible).

risks.risk: Condition unknown (may be damaged internally, leaking, or missing components).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports/seals, any cracks, and the fluid condition; plus a short video of it being tested (or at least a bench test / shift test).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven for working condition (worst case: treat as not working / needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (solenoids, sensors, torque converter, wiring harness connectors) that affect operation.
risks.proof: Photo inventory: all external sensors/solenoids, connector ends, and whether torque converter is included (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: assume missing items that require replacement).

risks.risk: Transmission fluid contamination or water ingress (common after improper storage/removal).
risks.proof: Photo of dipstick/fill opening (if present) and fluid color/condition; or a drain-and-catch photo showing fluid condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring fluid service/possible internal inspection (worst case: assume contaminated).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the transmission ID tag/label and any stamped transmission code/part number on the casing (must be readable).
Send the vehicle details it came from: Ford Fusion year + engine size + VIN (or at least engine code) so fitment can be confirmed.
Send photos of all sensors/solenoids/connectors and confirm whether torque converter is included (if applicable).
Send a short video of the gearbox being tested/shifted (or a mechanic’s test report).
response.reason: The photos show a gearbox, but there is no readable identification or vehicle/engine fitment info, and the seller’s Ford Fusion/4-cylinder claims are not verifiable from the images. Without the transmission code/part number and test/condition proof, a safe worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
